title: 2x4 Glossy Tiles (600x1200) in Coimbatore | Elite Balaji
description: 64 glossy 600 x 1200 mm (2x4 ft) tile designs: white and grey marble look, beige, soft colours, floral and wood look. See them at our Karamadai showroom.
intro: Our glossy collection is all 600 × 1200 mm, the 2 × 4 ft size that makes a hall or living room look bigger with fewer joints. There are 64 designs, from plain white marble looks to gold-veined, soft colour-wash, floral and wood looks.

Most designs come with several face designs that vary at random, so a large floor doesn't show the same pattern twice. Tell us the room and the look you like, and we'll send photos of what's in stock this week.

choose.title: Big rooms, fewer joints
choose.detail: A 2 × 4 ft tile covers 8 sq ft, so halls and living rooms need far fewer grout lines than with 2 × 2 tiles.

choose.title: Glossy reflects light
choose.detail: A glossy face brightens a room and suits halls and living areas. For bathrooms and wet areas, choose a matt or anti-skid floor tile instead.

choose.title: Lay it level
choose.detail: Large tiles need a flat bed and full adhesive cover. Our own crews lay them with levelling clips and the right adhesive.

choose.title: Order from one batch
choose.detail: Shade varies between production batches, so buy the full area in one lot, with a little extra for cutting.

faq.a: 600 × 1200 mm, about 2 × 4 feet, so each tile covers roughly 8 sq ft.
A glossy face is smooth, so it's best for halls, living and dining rooms and bedrooms. In bathrooms, balconies and wash areas, use a matt or anti-skid tile.

faq.q: Can I see the tiles before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with the design names you like and we'll share current photos, or visit our Karamadai showroom.

enquiry: Hi Elite Balaji, I'm interested in your 600 x 1200 glossy tiles. Design: ___, room: ___, area: ___ sq ft.
